evidence.excerpt: We introduce MCPHallu, a benchmark for diagnosing hallucination-prone agent failures in MCP environments along three axes: reasoning, execution, and memory.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing MCP benchmarks primarily measure task completion; where they diagnose failures, they do so after execution rather than building specific reasoning, execution, and memory failure risks into task construction.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: MCPHallu contains 358 tasks across five capability domains and runs on 36 production MCP servers in isolated containers.
